title: Structured Video Tokens @ Ego4D PNR Temporal Localization Challenge 2022

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Towards this end, we introduce two key concepts: (i) A set of transformer “objecttokens” – additional tokens initialized from learned embeddings (we refer to these embeddings as “object prompts”) that are meant to capture object-centric information in both still image and video.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Structured Video Tokens @ Ego4D PNR Temporal Localization Challenge 2022 This technical report describes the SViT approach for the Ego4D Point of No Return (PNR) Temporal Localization Challenge.

problems.name: Boundary Ambiguity and Localization Precision
problems.evidence_sentence: SViT obtains strong performance on the challenge test set with 0.656 absolute temporal localization error. # Abstract This technical report describes the SViT approach for the Ego4D Point of No Return (PNR) Temporal Localization Challenge.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
methods.evidence_sentence: To formalize the image structure, we proposed the HAnd-Object Graph (HAOG), a simple representation of the interactions between hands and objects in the scene. (ii) A novel “Frame-Clip Consistency loss” that ensures consistency between the “object-tokens” when they are part of a video vs. a still image.
